svg.title: Conditional small fire: prepare and control
svg.desc: Working preparation and control card used only while all ten Victorian fire gates remain yes. Prepare at least ten litres of extinguishing water already beside the fire in usable vessels or an immediately usable connected hose; it must be separate from drinking water the group needs or there is no fire. Also prepare a non-combustible turning tool, a labelled solid campfire firelighter product and three piles of dry, untreated, expressly permitted kindling. Keep all prepared fuel outside the three-metre clear area until needed. Use only a supplied public fireplace or the exact fireplace the current site rule specifically authorises. Use the pictured build only when the firelighter's current label permits its amount, base placement, kindling layout and ignition tool. Light only as the label directs. This exact sequence has not been live-fire tested.
svg.text: Conditional small fire — prepare and control
ONLY WHILE ALL TEN GO/NO-GO GATES STAY YES
Estimated wording accuracy: 75% for this untested exact sequence.
Live rules and conditions control. This card is not permission to light.
Other gate fails, fire contained, exit safe: stop fuel and extinguish.
Fire spreads or exit is threatened: move first; then 000, SOS or PLB.
No phone: activate satellite SOS or a PLB as its instructions direct.
Schematic—not a design, clearance scale or field-approved method.
1 PREPARE EVERYTHING BEFORE IGNITION
• At least 10 L of extinguishing water already beside the fire in
usable vessel(s), or an immediately usable connected hose.
Needed drinking water—or a source without delivery—does not count.
• Suitable non-combustible turning tool beside the water.
• Supplied public or specifically authorised fireplace.
• Labelled SOLID campfire firelighter. Its current label must permit
this amount, base position, kindling layout and ignition tool.
• Dry, untreated wood: lawfully obtained AND expressly permitted here.
• Three piles: match-thin, pencil-thick and thumb-thick.
Keep all piles outside the 3 m clear area until each is needed.
Each loose bundle: drink-can width; every piece fits in the fireplace.
Do not cut plants. No petrol, diesel, kerosene, methylated spirits,
aerosol, gas, liquid firelighter or stove fuel on a campfire.
Size progression is cross-checked; this exact build is not live-tested.
Prepare only while every rating, rule, site, wind and exit gate passes.
2 FIRST STAGE IN THE FIREPLACE — NO FLAME YET
Use this picture only if the firelighter label permits every step.
Place it on the base; loosely lean MATCH-THIN pieces as directed.
Label differs or omits this layout: STOP.
Missing directions: this build is unavailable.
Unlit/not to scale. An old ring, scar or improvised pit is not enough.
3 LIGHT ONLY AS THE LABEL DIRECTS
Light the firelighter only as its current label directs.
Use a carried lighter or waterproof match. Keep body and fuel away.
When match-thin pieces burn on their own, add pencil-thick pieces
a few at a time without crushing the air gaps.
When those burn on their own, add thumb-thick pieces slowly.
Do not add a larger stage until the smaller stage burns steadily.
Stage goes out, embers move or control is doubtful: extinguish.
Use the extinguishment card. Never leave the fire unattended.
WORKING DRAFT — NOT FIELD-APPROVED
